name: obsolete TLS publication restored
sourceDiff:
diff --git a/index.html b/index.html index 9c71750..c768f7d 100644 --- a/index.html +++ b/index.html @@ -738,7 +738,7 @@

TLS 1.3's current specification, - RFC 9846 (2026), + RFC 8446 (2018), obsoletes RFC 8446 and defines AEAD-based encrypted suites rather than CBC suites: AES-GCM, AES-CCM, and ChaCha20-Poly1305. Authenticated record protection prevents attacker-modified ciphertext from reaching an observable CBC padding branch.
namedTest: current TLS and CBC remediation claims
